title: Where I Went, and Where I Was
label: ch:ur-where-i-went-and-where-i-was
canDo: I can say where someone went and where someone was (voh gayā, voh gaī, maiṅ ghar par thā), and what I used to do (jātā thā).

payoff.summary: Complete UR-R264-where-i-went: say where someone went, where someone was, and what you used to do.
